## Deal

`Deal extends Opportunity` — literal card adoption, so one Pipeline Board renders both and the stage enum lives on Opportunity. Adds negotiation-phase fields: `terms` (markdown), `competitors` (containsMany string), `decisionMakers = linksToMany(Contact)`.

Inherits atom/embedded/fitted from Opportunity; overrides isolated to add Decision Makers and Terms panels.

When a Deal reaches closed won, the Close-Won chain command takes over (Contract → Subscription → first Invoice).

**Non-goals:** contract legalese (Contract card, v1.1), order line items (Order's job), duplicate stage machinery — it IS an Opportunity.
